title: Trump bows to pressure, replaces US cyber security director
text:
NewsFeed

Trump bows to pressure, replaces US cyber security director

President Trump has removed National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross and named a Defense Department official as an interim replacement. Cairncross’s departure comes amid major US technology outages, though officials say there is no evidence they were cyberattacks.
